verdict.rationale: Google documents the APIs Explorer as an embedded console on Workspace REST method reference pages. It shows parameters, credentials, code samples and live execution, so users can try methods without writing code. It is reinforced by per-method reference pages and a machine-readable Discovery Document. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Explorer on Workspace pages, and a sandboxed or test-data mode (the Explorer acts on real data, so runnable examples carry live-mutation risk).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
